title.narrative: EU Support for Participation in EU Programmes and Agencies for 2023 and 2024 TR-AAP-2023

description.narrative: Participation in EU programmes and agencies is an important element covered under Window 2: Good governance, European Union (EU) acquis alignment, good neighbourly relations and strategic communication of the IPA III Programming Framework. Through its participation in the EU programmes and agencies, Türkiye has the opportunity to: (i) build knowledge and capacities of the different stakeholders dealing with European issues; (ii) actively participate in the implementation of EU policies; and (iii) intensify international cooperation and mobility in relation to EU countries, thus becoming more deeply involved in the EU integration process. Participation in EU programmes and agencies encourages the active involvement of public and private institutions, small and medium-sized enterprises, NGOs, civil society organisations and universities to benefit from and contribute to the EU accession process. The European Commission invites Türkiye to participate in as many EU programmes and agencies as possible in line with its national priorities and goals. For 2021-2027 period Türkiye continues to participate in the following EU programmes and agencies: Horizon Europe, Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps (ESC), Union Civil Protection Mechanism (UCPM), Customs, Single Market Programme, European Environment Agency (EEA) and the European Monitoring Centre for Drugs and Drug Addiction (EMCDDA). As of August 2023, the association negotiations for the participation in Digital Europe Programme were concluded and those for the participation in Creative Europe were nearly concluded. There is an expectation that these two agreements will be signed in 2023. Türkiye may assess and consider to participate in other EU programmes and agencies for 2021-2027 period. Thereby, financial contribution for participation in the programmes, the so-called, ¿entry ticket¿ will incrementally increase in the upcoming years.In this regard, this Action Document (AD) lays out the need for EU support for Türkiye¿s participation in the EU programmes and agencies in the form of co-financing of the entry tickets to be paid by Türkiye in the years of 2023 and 2024.
